headline: From first launch to choosing a real Leela journey
overview: A live walk through the actual iPhone app: language selection, three-part onboarding, the native home, game-mode selection, and the On the Board journey choices.

steps.title: The native journey starts with language
steps.action: Launched Leela Quest after reinstalling the simulator build.
steps.description: The real iPhone app opens with an explicit language choice before it explains the game.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest native language selection on iPhone

steps.title: Ancient wisdom is framed as a modern practice
steps.description: The first native onboarding screen explains the five-thousand-year-old self-discovery game and its modern guided interpretation.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest Ancient Wisdom Awaits onboarding screen

steps.title: The game is positioned as divine play
steps.action: Advanced to the second onboarding card.
steps.description: The app sets the expectation that chance opens a reflection rather than predicting an outcome.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest Divine Play onboarding screen

steps.title: The user is asked to bring an intention
steps.action: Advanced to the final onboarding card.
steps.description: The native flow closes onboarding by connecting the board to a question the player genuinely wants to explore.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest Your Journey Begins onboarding screen

steps.title: The home screen resumes a real quest
steps.description: The actual native home shows streak, journey context, rewards, and a clear New Quest action. The simulator already held a synthetic seeded journey; no personal account data was entered for this walk.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest native home with seeded journey and New Quest action

steps.title: New Quest exposes distinct ways to play
steps.description: On the Board, conversational, multiplayer, and card-based entries are presented as separate native modes with their own purpose and credit cost.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest native game mode selection

steps.title: On the Board branches by commitment
steps.description: The native app offers Full Game, Daily Practice, and Real Board companion paths before an intention or credit is committed.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest native On the Board journey choices

keyFeatures: Full, daily, and real-board play paths
note: Captured from the actual com.humanquest.leela iPhone simulator build, version 1.2.18+72, on iOS 26.5. The installed binary predated the current source HEAD, so no source SHA is claimed. A synthetic seeded journey persisted outside the reinstalled app container; no account, purchase, or personal data was created.
